## Hero

Research / Build / Cardano first

### Building trust into digital payments.

We're a research and product studio working at the intersection of blockchain, applied AI, and stablecoin payments. Our first product is Hokan, an on-chain escrow platform. Cardano first, with more chains to follow.

Backed by Draper Dragon (https://www.draperdragon.com/)

## 01 / Our first product

### Hokan: on-chain escrow for a global economy.

Funds are locked by a smart contract and released when both sides agree the work is done. We never hold them. Built for teams paying contributors across borders, where trust is the expensive part. It ships on Cardano first, with more chains to follow.

Learn more: https://usehokan.com/

How the escrow flow works, in order:
- Step 1. Payee — Buyer pays with USDM or USDCx
- Step 2. Funds locked — Held in a Cardano smart contract
- Step 3. Contract validates — Both sides confirm the agreed conditions
- Step 4. Funds released — Paid to the recipient, on-chain

Specifications:
- Network: Cardano first
- Assets: ADA · USDM · USDCx
- Custody: Smart contract, never us
- Settlement: On-chain

## 02 / The bigger picture

### A trust layer for internet commerce.

Escrow is just the beginning. We're building the infrastructure for a more open, programmable economy where both humans and AI agents can transact with confidence.

Global use cases:
- Real utility.
- Real users.
- A more open economy.

The trust layer supports:
- Marketplaces — Buy and sell with confidence
- Agent-to-agent payments — Autonomous commerce
- Trade & import/export — Global commerce and supply chains
- Dispute resolution — Fair and transparent outcomes
- Milestone payments — Project-based work and delivery
- Digital services — Software, content and subscriptions
- Freelance work — Services and gig economy

## 03 / Where we're looking

### Research today. Real-world impact tomorrow.

We're exploring the areas where blockchain, stablecoins and AI can unlock something that wasn't possible before.

#### 01 Blockchain infrastructure

The plumbing underneath. Settlement, custody, and the tooling that makes on-chain systems usable by people who would rather not think about chains.

Keywords: Settlement, Custody, Multi-chain, Wallet UX

#### 02 AI escrow and payments

Escrow and payments where one or both parties is an AI agent: agents that can commit funds, prove work was done, and get paid, with a human able to step in when it matters.

Keywords: Agent-to-agent, Proof of work done, Human override

#### 03 Stablecoin payments

Moving value across borders for the cost of a message, and the product and regulatory questions that come with it.

Keywords: USDM · USDCx, Cross-border, On/off ramps
